Number of tasks: 2, reply said 'layouts or tasks' / 'environment variants' (levels). It also says 'mixing 2-3 fixed layouts or tasks'. Layout 1: border, inner walls and east strip only. Actions 1: reads 5 outputs as moves, but states it does not commit to any output-to-action mapping. Activation: 'Presumably ReLU' / 'A ReLU MLP' is a default, 0 points; counted as hedged ('presumably'), so no deduction. Ruling: I deduct ReLU only when it is asserted with no hedge anywhere in the reply. Depth level 1: the output mapping attempt failed, no correct layer-to-output conclusion.
